scope_note: Freud did not classify every form of transference as resistance; his 1912 restriction is retained rather than collapsed into a blanket equation.
statement: Freud restricted transference's role as resistance to negative transference and positive transference involving repressed erotic impulses.
statement_zh: Freud 把作為阻抗的移情限定為負向移情，以及涉及被壓抑色情衝動的正向移情。
